title: "Homework 2 Dashboard"
output: 
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    theme: darkly
    orientation: columns
    vertical_layout: fill

---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(tidyverse)
library(p8105.datasets)
library(plotly)
```


```{r echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}
noaa = 
  ny_noaa |> 
  slice_head(n = 5000) |> 
  janitor::clean_names() |> 
  separate(date, into = c("year", "month", "day"), sep = "\\-") |> 
  unite(date, year,month, sep = ".") |> 
  mutate(
    id = as.factor(id),
    snow = as.integer(snow),
    prcp = prcp / 10) |> 
  select(id:snwd, -day) |> 
  filter(!is.na(prcp))


noaa_tmin = 
  ny_noaa |> 
  filter(!is.na(tmin)) |> 
  janitor::clean_names() |> 
  separate(date, into = c("year", "month", "day"), sep = "\\-") |> 
  unite(date, year,month, sep = ".") |> 
  mutate(
    tmin = as.integer(tmin),
    tmax = as.integer(tmax),
    tmin = tmin / 10) |> 
  select(-day)
```

{data-width=650 .tabset}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Scatterplot

```{r echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
noaa |> 
  group_by(id, date) |> 
  summarize(
    prcp = mean(prcp),
    snow = mean(snow, na.rm=TRUE)) |> 
  plot_ly(
    x=~date, 
    y=~prcp, 
    color =~snow, 
    type ="scatter", 
    mode = "markers", 
    colorbar = list(title = list(text = "Snow (mm)"))) |> 
  layout(
    title = list(text = 'Average Precipitation vs Snowfall from 2007-2010', y =0.99, x = 0.5), 
    xaxis = list(title="Date (Year.Month)"), 
    yaxis = list(title="Precipitation (mm)"))
```

### Boxplot

```{r echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
noaa|> 
  filter(
    str_detect(date, "2010")) |> 
  mutate(
    id = as.character(id)) |> 
  filter( 
    id !="US1NYAB0016") |> 
  mutate(
    id = as.factor(id)) |> 
  plot_ly(
    x=~id, 
    y=~prcp, 
    color =~id, 
    type ="box") |> 
  layout(
    title = list(text = 'Precipitation of Active Weather Stations in 2010', y =0.99, x = 0.5), 
    xaxis = list(title="Weather Station"), 
    yaxis = list(title="Precipitation (mm)"))
```


### 2D-Histogram

```{r echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}
noaa_tmin |> 
  plot_ly(
    x =~date,
    y =~tmin,
    type = 'histogram2d') |> 
  layout(
    title = list(
      text = "Minimum Temperature Distributions by Month: 1981 to 2010", y = 0.99, x =0.5),
         xaxis = list(
           title = "Date (Year.Month)"),
         yaxis = list(
           title = "Daily Minimum Temperature (°C)"))

```
